entities.summary: Oscar Azarcón Solís is a Filipino-American prelate of the Catholic Church who has served as bishop of Salt Lake City in Utah since 2017. He previously served as an auxiliary bishop for the Archdiocese of Los Angeles in California from 2003 to 2017.
